dct_description_sm: The purpose was to 1) characterize the temporal variations of the algal biomass, community composition, and DMSP (particulate and dissolved) in landfast first-year sea ice and in the water column during the melt period in the Canadian Arctic Archipelago, and 2) identify the mechanisms responsible for the release of chlorophyll a (Chl a) and DMSP from the ice into the water column.
dct_title_s: Dimethylsulfoniopropionate (DMSP) in sea ice and underlying water column, Resolute Passage
